plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.S. in Integrated Information Technology, Molinaroli College of Engineering and Computing, Dept. of Integrated Information Technology, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_iit_map.pdf). 8 semesters plus a required 6-credit summer professional internship (ITEC 495) after junior year, transcribed as its own term. Semester sums verified against printed totals (16/15/15/15/15/14/6/12/12 at slot minimums = 120, matches Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 36 major, 44 college/program, 34 Carolina Core, 2.00 institutional GPA). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: CSCE 104 (3) vs CSCE 145 (4); ITEC 352 (3) vs CSCE 146 (4). Program note: the ITEC program requires either ACCT 222 + an approved elective OR both RETL 261 and 262 (map places ACCT 222/RETL 261 in Sem 3 and a RETL 262-linked elective in Sem 4). Retrieved 2026-10-09.
